description: C3 regulatory corpus: the complete Inland Revenue Act No. 24 of 2017 series as listed on the Inland Revenue Department's Acts page (https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/sitepages/acts.aspx), checked 2026-10-12: the principal Act and all six amendment Acts (English). The PP1 evaluation covers two rules (personal relief; individual income tax bands), which are changed only by the 2017 Act and Amendments No. 10 of 2021, No. 45 of 2022 and No. 2 of 2025; the other amendments are in the corpus for completeness and as realistic distractors for retrieval. operative_from is null where different sections take effect on different dates.

documents.title: Inland Revenue Act, No. 24 of 2017
documents.relevance: Principal Act: First Schedule para 1 (individual rates), Fifth Schedule para 2(a) (personal relief)

documents.title: Inland Revenue (Amendment) Act, No. 10 of 2021
documents.relevance: s.51 individual rates from 2020-01-01; s.55 personal relief Rs. 3,000,000 from 2020-01-01 (enacted retrospectively)

documents.title: Inland Revenue (Amendment) Act, No. 45 of 2022
documents.relevance: s.33 individual rates (YoA 2022/23 split, from YoA 2023/24); s.36 personal relief Rs. 1,200,000

documents.title: Inland Revenue (Amendment) Act, No. 4 of 2023
documents.relevance: Outside PP1 rules: e.g. new First Schedule para 13 (15% on dividend gains); amends paras 4 and 10

documents.title: Inland Revenue (Amendment) Act, No. 14 of 2023
documents.relevance: Outside PP1 rules: repeals First Schedule para 8 (retirement and provident fund rates)

documents.title: Inland Revenue (Amendment) Act, No. 2 of 2025
documents.relevance: s.3 individual rates from YoA 2025/26; s.5 personal relief Rs. 1,800,000

documents.title: Inland Revenue (Amendment) Act, No. 11 of 2026
documents.relevance: Outside PP1 rules (checked): s.36 changes First Schedule para 1(2)(a) gains rate 10% to 15%, not the para 1(1) bands; ss.5 and 40 change qualifying payments (Fifth Schedule para 1), not personal relief
